findings.note: Two required checks are marked passes:true, but both declared evidence files are explicitly absent from the bundle. The contract therefore lacks verifiable evidence for required regression and placeholder-scan gates.

The supplied green logs stop at TEST-013af and predate the amended TEST-013ag–aj cases, while the contract claims current evidence including those cases. The new eligible:true fail-closed and falsy-value behaviors are present in test source but not demonstrated by the bundled execution evidence.

The PowerShell test accepts any nonzero, non-10 exit for a forbidden bare second positional argument and records exit 1, whereas the documented checker contract uses exit 2 for invalid invocation/input and the Bash twin asserts exactly exit 2. This weak assertion permits cross-runtime exit-contract divergence.
